test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: In the context of the passage, select the most appropriate option to fill in blank (2).
solution:
The correct answer is '**is**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the current relevance and importance of sustainability.
 
• The appropriate verb should convey the present necessity of sustainability.
 
• "**is**" fits well as it indicates its present role as a necessity and primary agenda worldwide.
 
• Other options ("**will be**", "**might be**", "**was**") do not fit the context of describing the present significance of sustainability.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Sustainability is no__ longer just a buzzword. It **__is__ **a necessity and the primary agenda of the world today. Like many other countries, India too is witnessing a growth of **___(3)___* *green economy. It **___(4)___* *estimated that India’s renewable energy target will create more than 3.4 million new job opportunities **___(5)___* *2030. In fact, a recent survey stated that a Sustainability Manager is going to be one of the top 10 jobs this decade.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **will be**: "Will be" indicates a future occurrence, which does not align with the current necessity being described.
 
• **might be**: "Might be" indicates a possibility rather than a current fact.
 
• **was**: "Was" indicates a past state, which does not reflect the current importance of sustainability.
